added: A stall with an empty shelf and less than $5 at dawn is topped up to $5
What each rival bought today stays on show until the next morning
Favoured Trade is asked after the prices flip, when one of your prices is tied
changed: Standing orders: the winner puts down a stake and gets it back for a full delivery; rivals no longer fill the gap
Upgrade costs: Juice Bar $6, Premium Display $5, Ripening Room $4, Order Book $3, Handcart $6; the Ripening Room makes green mangoes $1 cheaper and the Order Book pays $2 more a delivered piece
Tip Jar, Nest Egg and Sharp Ears rebalanced
A green mango costs $4; no customer wants mango on days 1 and 2
Stocking, pricing and evening turns with nothing to decide are skipped
A tie on cash and fruit sold is a shared win
fixed: A stall can no longer be stuck at $0 for the rest of the game
Mango Windfall's extra mangoes arrive ripe
The day story no longer counts pieces an earlier customer took

approval.evidence: Owner's answers on 2026-11-11 to the questions put after REP-101: Fix now? "Wait for everything". $0 rule: "Top up to $5 if shelf empty (Recommended)". Standing orders: first "lets think about reworking this mechanism, or should it stay", then "Stake instead of fines (Recommended)". Rival buys: "Show today's buys (Recommended)". Day 1: first "im leaning more towards only delaying mango customers", then "Delay mango customers only". Text voice: "Plain, with a Malaysian market feel". Empty steps, ticked: "Skip Stocking with nothing ripe, Evening only when you have a choice, Faster rush" (not ticked: buying ends itself at the limit). Rule gaps: "Go through them one by one", then ticked: "Juice Bar: rush sales only, Premium Display: not on guests, Sharp Ears: evening, once a day, Priority beats Nest Egg"; "Final tie is shared, One favour deck of 12, Event fixes (tested first)"; on Favoured Trade: "give the pros and cons for each option for favoured trades before the flip" (open). Trophies: "Change them to fit the rules (Recommended)". Printed freshness tracking: "Mock up options 1 and 2 first" (open).

title: Rules version 18: build the approved balance set, the top-up, staked standing orders and the rulings
problem: REP-101 found stalls knocked out at $0, two shopkeepers and three upgrades out of balance, the mango as the default buy, a standing-order fine that a broke winner does not pay, purchases that must be memorised, mango customers nobody can serve on days 1 and 2, and several rule gaps. The owner approved the changes in DEC-086.
scope: src/engine (data, game, ai), src/net/protocol.ts (rules and computer-player versions), server/room.ts (what each phone may see)
The smallest screen changes the new rules need (standing-order stake, today's buys on rival boxes, the top-up line, skipped steps)
RULES.md, tests, a simulation of the built rules against the targets
Favoured Trade played after the prices flip (DEC-088): a step between the prices and the rush, only when a holder has a tied price
exclusions: The text rewrite (DEC-087), the screen and card redesign, the trophies and the print kit: later packages
How freshness is tracked on the table and whether unsold fruit is kept: open decisions
